description: Stations near a driven polyline. Slow on long routes: at most 2000 input points, downsampled to 80. distanceLimitKm is capped at 15. Defaults to paid and free stations (preferFree false) and does not thin by vehicle range unless smartSuggestions is true.

connectors.description: Connector keys: CCS2, Type2, CHADEMO, GBT. Default Type2.

distanceLimitKm.description: Max km from the polyline. Default 10, max 15.

minimalPowerKw.description: Minimum station power in kW. Default 50.

points.description: Polyline vertices in drive order, each {lat, lng}. Minimum 2.

preferFree.description: When true, keep only free stations. Default false.

rangeLimitKm.description: Used only when smartSuggestions is true. Default 200.

smartSuggestions.description: When true, thin stops by vehicle range. Default false.

name: match_chargers_along_route
